settings.heading: The suede
settings.content: Brown, cut full, and soft enough to take the shape of a day. It will mark where your life marks it.

settings.heading: The scarf
settings.content: A flowered scarf, knotted at the handle, with a small tag hanging from the knot. It is the bag's piece of jewelry.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Packed and sent the long way on purpose. Gracious, calm returns within 30 days — write to the house and we'll sort it.

settings.heading: The pairing
settings.content: The bag and the scarf come from different makers. Choosing each of them, and knotting one to the other, is the house's work — and the whole idea behind In Her Purse.
